formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (q N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), 2 ≤ q → N = q ^ 2 + q + 1 → (∀ l : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => I p l)).card = q + 1) → (∀ p p' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → ∃! l : Fin N, I p l ∧ I p' l) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (N + N) C → (∀ p1 l1 : Fin N, I p1 l1 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C (fun k1 => decide (k1 = Fin.castAdd N p1 ∨ k1 = Fin.natAdd N l1)) = true) → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p2 : Fin N => z (Fin.castAdd N p2) = true)).card ≤ 2 → (Finset.univ.filter (fun l2 : Fin N => z (Fin.natAdd N l2) = true)).card ≤ 2 → (¬ ∃ p3 l3 : Fin N, I p3 l3 ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p3) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l3) = true) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = false) → (∀ p4 l4 : Fin N, I p4 l4 → PEqualNP.ReadK.readsAtMost C (N + N) [p4.val, N + l4.val] 2 = true) → N * q ≤ 100 * C.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: A plane of order q >= 2: N = q^2+q+1 points and lines, q+1 points on each line, two points on exactly one line; inputs points then lines. C has AND/OR gates only, each reading exactly two earlier wires, no constants; it is true at each input of one point and one line through it, false at every input with at most 2 points, at most 2 lines and no incident pair, and each incident pair has a proof tree reading x_p and y_l at most twice each. Then N q <= 100 size. A circuit computing incidence that is read-2 meets these hypotheses.
title: It is false that: Plane of order q: fan-in-two AND/OR circuits accepting incident pairs, sound on 2 points and 2 lines, read-2 at each incident pair: at least N
